authorization: User requested publication of current results; later completed results are a subsequent supplement.
selection_rule: All tasks whose two prompt arms each have all three completed repeats by the fixed wall-clock cutoff. No filtering by reward, validity, target, leakage, or status.
analysis_scope: Interim completion snapshot, not the full prespecified 690-run cohort. Late tasks may differ; full-cohort generalization is untested.
unchanged: All 414 training episodes, original split, model/effort, inference fingerprints, defense calibration and attacker specifications.
adaptation: Derived analysis reads analysis_split.json for primary evaluation membership. Original split.json and protocol.json remain byte-identical. Pretest sources preserved separately.
